notes:
Summary: enterprise legal-tech shop; primary goal = replace brittle keyword search + metadata filters with dense + sparse hybrid retrieval + reranking. Very sensitive to latency and per-query cost — legal review workflows require <200ms 95th for short queries and cost target ~<$0.0025/query at scale. Index scale = 30M-75M embeddings (documents + segmented pages).

Architecture constraints / preferences:
- Current stack: Postgres metadata + Elastic for faceted search; experimenting with Weaviate in dev and pgvector PoC.
- Must support connectors: Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, and Elastic vector integration. Key connector requirements: streaming upserts, bulk ingestion (100k vectors/hr baseline for warm ingest, bursts to 1M), incremental upsert idempotency, metadata schema mapping, boolean/term filters at query time, per-tenant isolation (namespaces), support for cosine & dot metrics, HNSW parameters exposure (ef/construction), index persistence for on-prem nodes, and graceful fallback to compact quantized indexes.
- Reranking flow desired: sparse candidate generation (Elastic BM25) -> dense recall via vector DB (top N=200) -> cross-encoder rerank (on dedicated GPU pool) -> final post-filtering by policy. Want built-in rerank adapter in platform to run candidate rerank inside dedicated runtime (avoid moving full vector payloads between services).

Performance / cost constraints:
- Target QPS: baseline 150 qps peak for internal legal search.
- Latency SLO: median <50ms for vector recall, 95th <200ms end-to-end after rerank (with canary fallback to sparse-only).
- Cost sensitivity: aiming for <$0.0025/query for vector recall component (excluding heavy cross-encoder cost). Request Redwood Optimize suggestions: batching windows, hotprefix caching, quantization profile for 8-bit retrieval.

Security / compliance notes:
- Data residency: EU-hosted customer data for EU clients; US corp data stays in US. Need private deployment or VPC with HSM-backed KMS. Retention controls and audit logs mandatory.

POC plan (agreed on 2026-02-24 call):
- Week 0: contract + SANITIZED dataset handshake (legal).
- Week 1: Redwood provision non-prod VPC + seed connector to pgvector and Weaviate in our testbed.
- Week 2: Ingest 5M vectors, run baseline BM25 vs hybrid recall tests.
- Week 3: Integrate cross-encoder rerank (small model) and measure end-to-end latency and rerank quality (MRR@10).
- Success criteria: recall improvement >20% over BM25 baseline; 95th percentile E2E latency <250ms in POC; per-query vector recall cost <= 0.003.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We need predictable economics — if vector recall spikes our cloud bill, we can't adopt."
- "On-prem option is non-negotiable for certain clients; encryption-at-rest + HSM for keys."
- "Connector ergonomics: one CLI + terraform module to wire up ingestion is preferred."
